skill.name: Commit/Navigate
skill.strategic_description: Scrolls/navigates the level forward so new terrain and enemies come into view (e.g., blocks, pipes, goombas, pits), while Mario may remain at similar screen coordinates or change vertical position slightly.

steps: Scan the path ahead for continuity, hazards, and blockers
Choose the safest forward route requiring minimal adjustment
Advance steadily along the chosen direction, adjusting only as needed
Restore stable forward progress after any evasive or corrective move
Confirm new area is revealed and progress remains established
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Keep Moving Right
contract.description: Hold Right to keep Mario advancing through the level. Use this whenever the path ahead is clear and the next obstacle or block is still in front of him, like approaching a question block from the left

common_preconditions: Mario is on controllable ground, platform, or in a recoverable movement state and the objective is to reveal more level ahead.
The path ahead is not already fully visible or progress requires camera/level scrolling to the right.

preconditions: Mario is on controllable ground, platform, or in a recoverable movement state and the objective is to reveal more level ahead.

steps: Assess the visible terrain immediately ahead for floor continuity, enemies, pipes, blocks, gaps, and elevation changes.
Begin moving right to force horizontal scrolling, favoring steady forward input over abrupt stops.
Keep Mario in a safe, controllable position while advancing; adjust with short jumps only as needed to clear small obstacles, enemies, or step-ups.
If a pit, tall obstacle, or enemy blocks direct ground movement, perform the minimal jump or positioning change necessary to continue moving right.

success_criteria: The screen has scrolled to reveal new terrain, obstacles, or enemies to the right.
Mario has maintained or improved forward position without taking unnecessary damage or losing control.
A new navigable section is visible and the agent is ready for the next decision.
abort_criteria: An immediate threat requires switching to a more specific survival, dodge, attack, or jump skill.
Forward movement is blocked by a situation requiring a different dedicated skill, such as a precise gap jump, enemy engagement, or vertical traversal.
Mario enters a non-recoverable state for this intent, such as falling into a pit, taking a hit that disrupts control, or becoming trapped/stalled without safe rightward progress.

skill.name: Inspect/Setup
skill.strategic_description: Mario performs a setup/inspection action that preserves his local position while the scene scrolls left, bringing upcoming blocks/enemies into view.

steps: Assess current local position and nearby environmental stability
Choose a brief stationary setup action revealing upcoming area
Confirm more forward context appears without meaningful position change
Release setup action if drift occurs or visibility suffices
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Check Start Position
contract.description: Checks Mario’s exact starting coordinates after a reset or room load to confirm where he spawned.

common_preconditions: Mario is on stable ground or another safe surface where a brief stationary action will not cause immediate damage.
The agent needs to reveal more of the upcoming area to the right without meaningfully changing Mario's local position.
execution_hint.state_transition_pattern: Mario performs a setup/inspection action that preserves his local position while
termination_cues: The camera/scene has scrolled left enough to expose additional upcoming blocks, enemies, or terrain to the right.
Mario's local on-screen position remains approximately the same throughout the inspection.
common_failure_modes: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
execution_hint.execution_description: Mario performs a setup/inspection action that preserves his local position while the scene scrolls left, bringing upcoming blocks/enemies into view.

preconditions: Mario is on stable ground or another safe surface where a brief stationary action will not cause immediate damage.
The agent needs to reveal more of the upcoming area to the right without meaningfully changing Mario's local position.
There is enough nearby safety margin that a short setup/inspection action will not force Mario into an enemy, hazard, pit, or moving obstacle.
steps: Stop intentional horizontal traversal so Mario remains approximately in place relative to the screen.
Perform a position-preserving setup action that causes the scene to scroll left and reveal more of the area ahead.
Maintain the action only briefly, watching the newly revealed terrain, blocks, gaps, and enemies.
Keep Mario's local position approximately unchanged; avoid committing to forward movement during the inspection.
As soon as enough upcoming information is visible, release the setup action and return to neutral control or the next planned action.
success_criteria: The camera/scene has scrolled left enough to expose additional upcoming blocks, enemies, or terrain to the right.
Mario's local on-screen position remains approximately the same throughout the inspection.
event.position_of_mario_changed is observed as the resulting effect of the setup/inspection action.
abort_criteria: Mario begins drifting into danger, losing footing, or moving too far from the intended local position.
An enemy, projectile, moving hazard, or collapsing platform creates an immediate threat requiring evasive action.
The setup action fails to produce useful scene reveal within a short window.
